resources.string: Everything runs on this phone. The wordlist, the relation graph and every search are inside the app, and the app has no network permission: Android itself refuses it any connection.
There is nowhere here to type a seed phrase, and there never will be. Never type a real one into anything.
Your keyboard is asked not to learn the words you type in the explorer.
